name: Gebann
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: is the father of the goddess Clidna
serves as chief druid to the sea god Manannan Mac Lir

text: Gebann is an obscure Irish god. He is known only as the father of the beautiful goddess Clidna and as the chief druid of the sea god Manannan Mac Lir. No other exploits or honors are recorded for him in the surviving sources.

okr.objective: Document Gebann as an obscure Irish deity known for two associations.
key_results: Establish Gebann as a Deity-typed Irish god
Record the father-daughter link to Clidna
Record the druid role under Manannan Mac Lir
